Medical Writer II OR Senior Medical Writer

• Compile, write, edit, and coordinate medical writing deliverables for clinical study and regulatory projects, working with minimal supervision.

  • Prepare and support a range of clinical and regulatory documents, including clinical study protocols and amendments, clinical study reports, patient narratives, annual reports, and investigator brochures.

  • Mentor less experienced medical writers on projects when required.

  • Review statistical analysis plans and table, figure, and listing specifications to ensure appropriate content, grammar, formatting, and consistency.

  • Collaborate with colleagues in data management, biostatistics, regulatory affairs, medical affairs, and other relevant departments to deliver accurate and complete documentation.

  • Participate in internal peer reviews, addressing comments and ensuring scientific accuracy, clarity, consistency, and appropriate formatting.

  • Ensure all deliverables comply with applicable regulatory standards and guidance, including ICH-E3, as well as relevant standard operating procedures, client requirements, and approved templates.

  • Conduct online clinical literature searches when needed to support writing assignments.

  • Keep up to date with changes in regulatory guidance, medical writing practices, and client expectations.

  • Monitor project budgets and allocated hours, communicating any anticipated changes to medical writing leadership.

  • Complete administrative responsibilities within established deadlines and undertake other related duties as assigned.

  • Be available for occasional travel, expected to remain below 25%.

    • Requirements:

  • A Bachelor of Science degree with relevant writing experience, or a Bachelor of Arts degree, preferably in Social Sciences, English, or Communications, supported by relevant scientific or medical knowledge and expertise.

  • Extensive knowledge of English grammar and strong medical and scientific writing skills.

  • Familiarity with FDA and ICH regulations and guidelines, as well as the AMA style guide.

  • Understanding of clinical research principles and the drug development process.

  • Ability to interpret and communicate clinical data and other complex scientific information accurately and clearly.

  • Strong proofreading, editing, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines and budgets.

  • Leadership skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach, including the ability to support and mentor colleagues.

  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, email, and internet-based research tools.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistency and accuracy across complex regulatory documents.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote working arrangement within the eligible European locations.

  • Full-time employment.

  • Career development and progression opportunities.

  • Supportive and engaged line management.

  • Technical and therapeutic-area training.

  • Peer recognition and a total rewards program.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with international specialists across clinical and regulatory functions.

  • Exposure to emerging technologies, scientific developments, data, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

  • Opportunities to explore different career paths within a global life sciences environment.

You will own the commercial relationships and franchise development pipeline, driving the identification, evaluation, negotiation, and closing of strategic partnerships. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Identify and approach qualified franchise development partners, master franchisees, multi-unit operators, restaurant groups, private equity-backed platforms, family offices, and strategic investors across the United States and Canada.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of credible development partners for selected European food, restaurant, and hospitality concepts.

  • Originate, qualify, negotiate, and close master franchise, area development, multi-unit franchise, and joint venture agreements.

  • Assess the commercial and operational viability of European concepts for North American markets, including unit economics, capital expenditure requirements, site development, labor, supply chain, and franchisee return on investment.

  • Evaluate potential partners based on financial capacity, operating experience, market knowledge, development capabilities, and strategic alignment.

  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations, ensuring that proposed franchise structures support sustainable growth for both brand owners and development partners.

  • Coordinate market-entry activities with brand owners, franchise partners, franchise counsel, and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Support the adaptation of European concepts to North American market conditions while preserving their core brand identity and positioning.

  • Contribute to market strategy, partner qualification, deal structuring, and expansion planning in collaboration with internal resources and external advisors.

  • Build a repeatable commercial platform capable of supporting the long-term expansion of multiple food and hospitality brands across North America.

  • Take ownership of development opportunities from initial outreach and relationship building through commercial evaluation, agreement negotiation, and partnership launch coordination.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a senior franchise development professional with a strong track record of closing multi-unit development deals and an established network of credible North American operators and investors. You should combine entrepreneurial drive with commercial expertise, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to evaluate whether a concept can succeed economically in a new market.

  • 10–15+ years of experience in franchise development, restaurant development, hospitality, or international business expansion.

  • Demonstrated success originating and closing multi-unit franchise agreements and strategic development partnerships.

  • An established network of multi-unit operators, restaurant groups, private equity-backed platforms, family offices, and strategic investors.

  • Strong understanding of restaurant unit economics, capital expenditure (CapEx), site development, labor models, supply chain considerations, and franchisee return on investment.

  • Proven experience negotiating master franchise, area development, multi-unit franchise, and joint venture structures.

  • Strong business development, relationship management, and owner-level negotiation capabilities.

  • Commercial judgment to assess the economic viability and scalability of international food concepts in the U.S. and Canadian markets.

  • Ability to adapt international concepts to local market expectations without compromising their brand identity.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and motivation to build a long-term expansion platform rather than simply manage an established franchise department.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence senior operators, investors, and brand owners.

  • Previous experience working with European food, restaurant, or hospitality brands is a significant advantage.

  • French or Spanish language skills are particularly valuable.

    • Benefits:

  • Founding Partner-level opportunity to build and lead a North American franchise development platform.

  • Significant ownership of commercial relationships, partner acquisition, negotiations, and the expansion pipeline.

  • Access to selected European food, restaurant, and hospitality concepts seeking entry into the U.S. and Canadian markets.

  • Support with market strategy, operator qualification, deal structuring, and coordination with brand owners and franchise counsel.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced operators, strategic investors, and international brand owners.

  • High-impact role with the opportunity to shape the long-term growth and development of multiple franchise concepts.

As Principal Data Architect, you will own enterprise data architecture direction while providing technical leadership and enabling teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and governed data solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Enterprise Data Strategy and Architecture

  • Define and lead the enterprise data architecture strategy, target-state vision, and multi-year roadmap for the data platform.

  • Establish reference architectures, standards, and technical guardrails for data ingestion, transformation, modeling, orchestration, quality, observability, and consumption.

  • Drive architectural decisions across enterprise data platforms, including enterprise data warehouses, lakehouses, streaming environments, operational data integration, and domain-oriented data products.

  • Partner with senior Technology and business leaders to align data investments with strategic priorities, business value, and long-term scalability.

  • Assess existing architecture, identify gaps, and lead the rationalization of tools, technical patterns, and accumulated technical debt.

  • Technical Leadership and Architecture Enablement

  • Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to data engineering, analytics engineering, and platform teams.

  • Establish standards for design quality, data model integrity, operational excellence, and scalable delivery.

  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders in architectural thinking, modern engineering practices, and effective delivery methods.

  • Promote an automation-first culture focused on reliability, repeatability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.

  • Strengthen technical quality, design rigor, and execution across the data engineering organization.

  • Platform and Solution Delivery

  • Design, develop, and oversee end-to-end enterprise data solutions supporting multiple data domains, data marts, and analytics use cases.

  • Guide the design and modernization of foundational enterprise data models, including grain, entities, relationships, conformed dimensions, and slowly changing dimensions.

  • Ensure scalable batch and streaming pipelines support enterprise reporting and advanced analytics environments.

  • Drive the adoption of layered data architecture patterns, such as Bronze/Silver/Gold or equivalent logical data zones.

  • Collaborate with Engineering teams to productionize data pipelines with strong performance, resilience, and operational supportability.

  • Data Reliability, Governance, and Operational Excellence

  • Own the reliability, quality, consistency, and observability of core enterprise data assets and pipelines.

  • Establish and enforce data quality frameworks, automated testing, lineage, monitoring, alerting, and recovery processes.

  • Define service levels and operational standards for critical data products and pipelines.

  • Reduce manual processes and technical debt through standardization, automation, and disciplined platform engineering.

  • Partner with security, compliance, and governance stakeholders to ensure architecture aligns with enterprise risk and control requirements.

  • Cross-Functional Influence and Innovation

  • Translate business challenges into scalable data products, architecture patterns, and prioritized roadmaps.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and business teams to ensure the data platform supports measurable business outcomes.

  • Lead proofs of concept, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations for emerging tools and capabilities.

  • Influence vendor selection, platform direction, and engineering standards through practical technical leadership and fact-based analysis.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and large language models (LLMs) to improve engineering productivity, data operations, governance, and insight generation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines extensive enterprise data architecture experience with strong technical expertise and a proven ability to lead engineering teams and influence strategic decisions. You should be comfortable designing complex data ecosystems, modernizing enterprise platforms, and translating business priorities into practical architecture and delivery plans.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. A Master's degree is preferred.

  • At least 12 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data platform leadership.

  • 5–10 years of experience leading, mentoring, and developing high-performing data engineering or analytics engineering teams.

  • Proven experience defining enterprise data strategies and leading large-scale modernization of data pipelines, platforms, and models.

  • Deep expertise in enterprise data modeling, including third normal form (3NF), dimensional modeling, star schemas, and snowflake schemas, with strong judgment in representing real-world business processes.

  • Extensive experience redesigning foundational data models and pipelines to improve scalability, usability, and reliability.

  • Expert-level SQL and Python skills.

  • Strong production experience with Informatica and dbt, including model development, testing, and package management.

  • Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Dagster, Tivoli, or comparable tools.

  • Familiarity with streaming and event-driven technologies such as Kafka or equivalent platforms.

  • Hands-on experience with modern data warehouse and lakehouse platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, or BigQuery.

  • Strong understanding of cloud-native engineering practices across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure.

  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering best practices, including Git, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, testing, and DRY design principles.

  • Experience implementing data quality, observability, lineage, and operational controls in production environments.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical leaders.

  • A data product mindset and the ability to translate business needs into architecture, roadmaps, and execution plans.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in insurance, SaaS, or marketplace environments.

  • Experience using Generative AI or LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini to solve meaningful business and engineering challenges.

  • Collaborate with development teams using the Traction methodology, supported by AI-powered tools.

  • Present sprint deliverables to business stakeholders, collect feedback, and secure formal acceptance of completed work.

  • Monitor customer data cleansing activities with the relevant teams, using outstanding-issue dashboards to track progress.

  • Coordinate test data preparation, test scenarios, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and final deployment rehearsals with client IT teams.

  • Oversee testing, validation, deployment readiness, and hypercare activities until the new operating model reaches stability.

  • Support project sponsors in go/no-go decisions before production deployment.

  • Triage, assess, and prioritize incidents during the hypercare period in coordination with the support teams responsible for the billing platform and SAP.

Senior Associate, Finance and Accounting Operations

You will oversee essential finance and accounting activities for the Brazilian entity, ensuring operational accuracy, regulatory compliance, and reliable financial reporting. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Coordinate and process advance and monthly payroll activities with external payroll providers, ensuring accurate calculations and timely execution.

  • Review payroll calculations, employee deductions, benefits, adjustments, and applicable statutory contributions.

  • Monitor and coordinate payroll-related tax payments and statutory remittances, including IRRF, INSS, FGTS, and other applicable obligations.

  • Work closely with payroll providers and internal stakeholders to investigate discrepancies, resolve payroll issues, and meet statutory deadlines.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for local accounting providers, coordinating the exchange of financial information and documentation required for Brazilian tax, statutory, and reporting compliance.

  • Maintain records, reconcile, and coordinate the remittance of taxes withheld from vendor payments, including IRRF, PIS, COFINS, and CSLL.

  • Support the preparation, review, and coordination of corporate income tax calculations, filings, and payments in collaboration with external tax and accounting specialists.

  • Monitor Brazilian tax regulations, statutory obligations, and filing deadlines to ensure ongoing compliance.

  • Prepare and coordinate intercompany invoicing, ensuring accurate transaction recording and appropriate supporting documentation.

  • Support external providers in preparing and maintaining transfer pricing documentation for transactions between Brazil and the United States.

  • Assist with tax reconciliations, statutory reporting, and documentation required for internal and external audits.

  • Maintain accurate accounting records in the Brazilian entity's local statutory books, including journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, and adjustments between reporting bases.

  • Support accounts payable, payment processing, bank reconciliations, and other routine financial operations.

  • Review financial transactions, identify inconsistencies, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to financial reporting, audit requests, internal controls, and compliance with corporate accounting policies.

  • Collaborate with regional finance teams and external accounting providers to improve month-end closing efficiency, strengthen documentation, and ensure the completeness and accuracy of statutory financial records.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline financial processes and contribute to the development of scalable local finance operations.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented finance professional with practical experience in Brazilian accounting, payroll operations, and tax compliance. You should be comfortable managing multiple financial processes, coordinating external service providers, and working with international teams while maintaining accuracy and meeting strict regulatory deadlines. Key qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

  • Between 4 and 6 years of relevant experience in finance operations, accounting, payroll accounting, or tax compliance support.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining Brazilian statutory accounting books and supporting local financial operations.

  • Working knowledge of Brazilian payroll regulations, statutory accounting requirements, and corporate tax obligations.

  • Experience with general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and month-end closing processes.

  • Familiarity with Brazilian payroll and tax obligations, including IRRF, INSS, FGTS, PIS, COFINS, and CSLL.

  • Experience coordinating with external payroll, tax, and accounting providers.

  • Understanding of intercompany transactions and transfer pricing documentation is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with ERP platforms or accounting systems.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, work independently, and consistently meet financial and regulatory deadlines.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with regional finance teams and external stakeholders.

  • Fluency in Portuguese and working proficiency in English are preferred.

    • Benefits:

  • Full-time employment under a Brazilian CLT contract, with a 40-hour working week.

  • Fully remote working arrangement, offering flexibility to work from home.

  • Private health insurance through SulAmérica Prestige, including coverage for eligible legal dependents.

  • Dental insurance through SulAmérica, also available for eligible legal dependents.

  • Life insurance through Prudential, providing coverage equivalent to 24 times the employee's salary.

  • Private pension plan through MetLife, with company contributions matching up to 6%.

  • Monthly meal voucher and internet allowance of R$1,000 through Flash.

  • Employee Assistance Program to support personal and professional well-being.

  • Access to a dedicated wellness program.

  • Additional compensation opportunities, subject to eligibility, including individual performance-based incentives.

  • Potential equity grant through the Associate Equity Appreciation Program.

  • Opportunities for professional development, continuous learning, and career growth within an international organization.

  • Inclusive and collaborative working environment that encourages innovation, knowledge sharing, and diversity.

• Manage the complete B2B sales cycle, from identifying and prospecting potential customers to negotiating and closing new business.
  • Generate your own leads and build a consistent pipeline of qualified US-based small and medium-sized business prospects.
  • Conduct compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations, highlighting the value of VoIP phone systems, AI voice agents, and managed IT services.
  • Engage directly with business owners and decision-makers, understand their operational challenges, and recommend tailored solutions.
  • Handle objections, negotiate commercial terms, and confidently move prospects toward purchasing decisions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, prospect interactions, follow-ups, and deal progress.
  • Consistently work toward sales targets while demonstrating measurable results and strong ownership of individual performance.

    • Requirements

  • At least 3 years of proven full-cycle B2B sales experience, independently managing prospecting, demonstrations, negotiations, and deal closures.
  • Demonstrated experience selling to US-based small and medium-sized businesses.
  • Verifiable track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas, supported by commission statements or previous employer CRM and quota reports.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with near-native fluency and the confidence to communicate professionally with US business owners throughout the working day.
  • Strong prospecting, negotiation, objection-handling, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent CRM management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage pipelines, follow-ups, and sales documentation.
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.
  • Ability to provide details of at least one independently closed B2B deal, including customer industry and size, deal value, sales cycle duration, and a former colleague or manager who can verify the results.
  • Willingness to provide supporting sales performance documentation and two professional references (a former manager or customer) during the selection process.
  • Previous experience in SaaS, VoIP, telecommunications, UCaaS, or managed IT services (MSP) is highly desirable.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive monthly base salary: Approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD gross, with compensation negotiable based on experience and demonstrated sales performance.
  • Uncapped commission structure: Earn 100% of each new customer's first-month package price, excluding taxes, usage charges, overages, one-time fees, consulting, labor, and hardware.
  • Performance-driven earning potential: Opportunity to significantly increase total compensation through successful deal closures.
  • Fully remote position: Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Full-time schedule: Monday through Friday, with consistent working hours aligned with US Eastern Time.
  • Autonomy and ownership: Manage your own prospecting activities, sales pipeline, customer relationships, and closing strategy.
  • Growth opportunity: Work in a technology-focused environment offering business communication, AI voice, and managed IT solutions to the US market.

    • Application Process

    Applicants must complete the following steps in order:

    1. Record a 2-minute sales pitch: Before submitting written answers, record an audio or video pitch addressed to a US dental office owner who says, "We're happy with our current phones." Present the value of an AI-powered phone system using your own voice and words. AI-generated voices, scripts, or application responses are not accepted.
    2. Share a verifiable sales success story: Describe one B2B deal you personally closed, including the customer's industry and company size, deal value (monthly or annual), sales cycle duration, and a contact at your previous employer who can verify the transaction.
    3. Provide supporting evidence: Be prepared to share commission statements or CRM/quota reports demonstrating your sales performance, along with two professional references (a former manager or customer).

  • Conduct compelling product demonstrations and sales presentations, highlighting the value of VoIP phone systems, AI voice agents, and managed IT services.
  • Engage directly with business owners and decision-makers, understand their operational challenges, and recommend tailored solutions.
  • Handle objections, negotiate commercial terms, and confidently move prospects toward purchasing decisions.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records, including pipeline activity, prospect interactions, follow-ups, and deal progress.
  • Consistently work toward sales targets while demonstrating measurable results and strong ownership of individual performance.

    • Requirements

  • At least 3 years of proven full-cycle B2B sales experience, independently managing prospecting, demonstrations, negotiations, and deal closures.
  • Demonstrated experience selling to US-based small and medium-sized businesses.
  • Verifiable track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas, supported by commission statements or previous employer CRM and quota reports.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with near-native fluency and the confidence to communicate professionally with US business owners throughout the working day.
  • Strong prospecting, negotiation, objection-handling, presentation, and closing skills.
  • Excellent CRM management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently manage pipelines, follow-ups, and sales documentation.
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time.
  • Ability to provide details of at least one independently closed B2B deal, including customer industry and size, deal value, sales cycle duration, and a former colleague or manager who can verify the results.
  • Willingness to provide supporting sales performance documentation and two professional references (a former manager or customer) during the selection process.
  • Previous experience in SaaS, VoIP, telecommunications, UCaaS, or managed IT services (MSP) is highly desirable.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive monthly base salary: Approximately $2,000–$3,000 USD gross, with compensation negotiable based on experience and demonstrated sales performance.
  • Uncapped commission structure: Earn 100% of each new customer's first-month package price, excluding taxes, usage charges, overages, one-time fees, consulting, labor, and hardware.
  • Performance-driven earning potential: Opportunity to significantly increase total compensation through successful deal closures.
  • Fully remote position: Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Full-time schedule: Monday through Friday, with consistent working hours aligned with US Eastern Time.
  • Autonomy and ownership: Manage your own prospecting activities, sales pipeline, customer relationships, and closing strategy.
  • Growth opportunity: Work in a technology-focused environment offering business communication, AI voice, and managed IT solutions to the US market.

    • Application Process

    Applicants must complete the following steps in order:

    1. Record a 2-minute sales pitch: Before submitting written answers, record an audio or video pitch addressed to a US dental office owner who says, "We're happy with our current phones." Present the value of an AI-powered phone system using your own voice and words. AI-generated voices, scripts, or application responses are not accepted.
    2. Share a verifiable sales success story: Describe one B2B deal you personally closed, including the customer's industry and company size, deal value (monthly or annual), sales cycle duration, and a contact at your previous employer who can verify the transaction.
    3. Provide supporting evidence: Be prepared to share commission statements or CRM/quota reports demonstrating your sales performance, along with two professional references (a former manager or customer).

Senior Backend Engineer, Identity and Access Management

• Develop core authorization services: Design, build, and maintain the authorization platform, including permission and role models, capability evaluation, sharing mechanisms, and access-control primitives. Implement reliable inheritance semantics across hierarchical resources, from workspaces and spaces to folders, lists, and tasks.

  • Build enterprise permission models: Extend the authorization engine to support configurable access management, including reusable permission profiles, granular capability catalogs, delegated grant scopes, and inherited policy restrictions. Ensure that higher-level restrictions always take precedence over permissions granted at lower levels.

  • Develop authentication and identity services: Build and operate authentication and user-provisioning capabilities, including single sign-on (SSO) through SAML and OIDC, integrations with identity providers, multi-factor authentication (MFA), session and token lifecycle management, OAuth, API tokens, and SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning.

  • Ensure consistent access decisions: Own the permission evaluation process end to end, establishing a centralized, authoritative server-side decision that is consistently applied across APIs, user interfaces, automations, and AI agents, without unauthorized bypass paths.

  • Improve access transparency and auditability: Implement events, decision explanations, and audit trails that enable administrators to understand why a user has access to a resource or why a sharing request was denied.

  • Lead safe data and system migrations: Design and execute migrations involving sensitive, high-impact permission data. Use approaches such as shadow evaluation, dual reads, backfills, and staged feature-flag rollouts to verify that existing access rights are preserved and no unintended permissions are granted or revoked.

  • Maintain performance and reliability: Ensure that authorization services remain fast, reliable, and scalable across critical product request paths. Participate in the shared identity and access management on-call rotation.

  • Collaborate on enterprise security solutions: Work with frontend, product, design, and information security teams to deliver precise, predictable, and usable access controls. Contribute technical expertise during enterprise security reviews.

  • Adopt AI-native engineering practices: Use AI tools and agents regularly throughout the development workflow. Structure work and documentation so that AI agents can support task coordination, progress tracking, and reporting within an asynchronous working environment.

    • Requirements

  • Backend engineering experience: At least 5 years of professional experience building and operating production backend systems for SaaS products at scale.

  • Authorization and access-control expertise: Hands-on experience designing and building authorization or access-control systems, including permission and role models such as RBAC, ReBAC, or ABAC, policy evaluation, access-control lists, or centralized authorization services. Experience consuming existing authorization solutions alone is not sufficient.

  • Hierarchical permissions knowledge: Direct experience implementing inherited permissions across resource hierarchies, including understanding how access is granted, inherited, overridden, and revoked. Ability to design accurate and efficient effective-permission resolution.

  • Backend technologies and API design: Strong command of a modern backend stack, with experience designing APIs and data models that other engineering teams rely on. Experience with TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kafka is relevant, while deep expertise in comparable technologies is also valuable.

  • Authentication and identity standards: Practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), session and token lifecycle management, MFA, and SCIM provisioning.

  • Multi-tenant architecture: Experience operating systems in multi-tenant environments where strict tenant isolation and access correctness are essential.

  • Migration experience: Demonstrated ability to deliver database schema and behavioral migrations on live, high-traffic systems without disrupting existing customers or compromising access controls.

  • Security-first engineering: Strong understanding of secure system design, including server-side authorization, deny-by-default principles, privilege escalation risks, potential failure modes, and the operational impact of security decisions.

  • Problem-solving and systems thinking: Excellent debugging and analytical skills, with the judgment to distinguish when a reusable abstraction is appropriate and when a focused, practical solution is preferable.

  • Communication and documentation: Strong written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an asynchronous environment, documenting technical decisions, sharing context, and collaborating without relying on frequent meetings.

  • AI fluency: Daily experience using AI tools as part of software engineering workflows, with the ability to apply them thoughtfully and effectively.

    • Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced authorization frameworks: Experience with Google Zanzibar-style authorization, relationship-based access control, or open-source policy and authorization engines such as SpiceDB, OpenFGA, Oso, Cerbos, or OPA.

  • Service architecture: Experience extracting identity or authorization functionality from a monolithic application into dedicated services.

  • Administrative access management: Experience building administrator-facing tools such as custom role builders, permission catalogs, delegated administration features, access-explainability tools, or "view as" functionality.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Analyst – M&A based in India. We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded Senior Business Analyst to support complex mergers and acquisitions, strategic investments, divestitures, and business partnerships across multiple industries. In this role, you will combine financial expertise, strategic thinking, and rigorous market analysis to evaluate investment opportunities and support high-impact corporate transactions. You will contribute throughout the entire M&A lifecycle, from opportunity identification and due diligence to valuation, negotiation, and deal execution. Working with international stakeholders and specialist advisors, you will assess financial performance, operational capabilities, market positioning, and transaction risks. You will also help shape corporate strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business portfolios, and developing investment recommendations. This is an opportunity to contribute to major strategic decisions within a fast-paced, globally distributed, and innovation-driven environment.
  • Conduct comprehensive commercial, financial, and operational due diligence on acquisition targets, investment opportunities, and strategic assets, coordinating insights from legal, tax, technical, and other specialist advisors.
  • Develop, maintain, and review sophisticated financial models, including Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Leveraged Buyout (LBO), merger and accretion/dilution, sum-of-the-parts, comparable company, and precedent transaction analyses.
  • Support the complete M&A transaction lifecycle, from deal origination, opportunity screening, and valuation to transaction structuring, negotiation support, and closing, across both buy-side and sell-side activities.
  • Contribute to corporate and business-unit strategy projects, including market sizing, industry research, competitive benchmarking, growth strategy development, portfolio assessments, and investment thesis preparation.
  • Prepare high-quality investment memoranda, information memoranda, pitch books, valuation reports, and presentations for senior management, boards, and investment committees.
  • Monitor M&A transactions, capital markets, industry developments, and competitive trends to identify and prioritize potential investment and partnership opportunities.
  • Coordinate transaction execution activities, including data room management, collaboration with legal teams and external advisors, communication with counterparties, and review of transaction documentation such as term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs), and shareholder agreements.
  • Evaluate regulatory, geopolitical, environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and integration-related risks, contributing to synergy assessments and post-merger integration planning.
  • Analyze and structure alternative transaction arrangements, including asset and share acquisitions, joint ventures, minority investments, earn-outs, deferred and contingent consideration, and structured or hybrid financing solutions.
  • Assess the financial, commercial, and counterparty implications of different transaction structures, including royalties, streams, prepayments, and offtake agreements.
  • Translate complex financial and operational findings into clear, actionable recommendations that support strategic and investment decisions.

    • Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mergers and acquisitions, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or strategy consulting.
  • Hands-on experience supporting or executing live M&A transactions, on either the buy-side or sell-side, is highly desirable.
  • Additional business qualifications or professional training, such as an MBA, progress toward CFA certification, or equivalent practical commercial experience, are advantageous.
  • Strong knowledge of financial modeling, corporate valuation methodologies, transaction analysis, and acquisition financing instruments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of transaction structures and documentation, including term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements, shareholder agreements, and other relevant legal and commercial agreements.
  • Experience applying strategy consulting methodologies and structured problem-solving approaches, including hypothesis-driven analysis, market research, industry assessment, and competitive analysis.
  • Ability to interpret complex commercial, operational, and financial information and translate findings into clear investment recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using financial databases and research platforms such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg, or PitchBook considered an advantage.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with excellent written and verbal abilities for preparing professional reports, investment materials, and executive-level presentations.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities, combined with sound commercial judgment and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and transaction workstreams simultaneously while meeting demanding deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, external advisors, and senior decision-makers.
  • Previous experience in mining and metals, agribusiness, or infrastructure is considered a significant advantage.
  • Exposure to cross-border transactions, additional language capabilities, and willingness to travel internationally to meet target companies, visit assets, and engage with counterparties are desirable.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote opportunity: Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Global exposure: Participate in complex M&A transactions, strategic investments, and business development opportunities across multiple industries and geographical markets.
  • High-impact responsibilities: Contribute directly to significant investment decisions, corporate strategy initiatives, and transaction execution.
  • Professional development: Expand your expertise in financial analysis, corporate finance, valuation, deal structuring, and strategic consulting.
  • International collaboration: Work alongside experienced professionals, specialist advisors, and senior stakeholders across a globally distributed organization.
  • Career advancement: Gain valuable exposure to complex transactions and strategic projects in a dynamic, innovation-focused environment.
  • Compensation: Competitive remuneration package, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and demonstrated expertise.
  • Continuous learning: Opportunity to deepen industry knowledge and develop expertise across emerging markets, investment opportunities, and diverse business sectors.

Working with international stakeholders and specialist advisors, you will assess financial performance, operational capabilities, market positioning, and transaction risks. You will also help shape corporate strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business portfolios, and developing investment recommendations. This is an opportunity to contribute to major strategic decisions within a fast-paced, globally distributed, and innovation-driven environment.
  • Conduct comprehensive commercial, financial, and operational due diligence on acquisition targets, investment opportunities, and strategic assets, coordinating insights from legal, tax, technical, and other specialist advisors.
  • Develop, maintain, and review sophisticated financial models, including Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Leveraged Buyout (LBO), merger and accretion/dilution, sum-of-the-parts, comparable company, and precedent transaction analyses.
  • Support the complete M&A transaction lifecycle, from deal origination, opportunity screening, and valuation to transaction structuring, negotiation support, and closing, across both buy-side and sell-side activities.
  • Contribute to corporate and business-unit strategy projects, including market sizing, industry research, competitive benchmarking, growth strategy development, portfolio assessments, and investment thesis preparation.
  • Prepare high-quality investment memoranda, information memoranda, pitch books, valuation reports, and presentations for senior management, boards, and investment committees.
  • Monitor M&A transactions, capital markets, industry developments, and competitive trends to identify and prioritize potential investment and partnership opportunities.
  • Coordinate transaction execution activities, including data room management, collaboration with legal teams and external advisors, communication with counterparties, and review of transaction documentation such as term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements (SPAs), and shareholder agreements.
  • Evaluate regulatory, geopolitical, environmental, social, and governance (ESG), and integration-related risks, contributing to synergy assessments and post-merger integration planning.
  • Analyze and structure alternative transaction arrangements, including asset and share acquisitions, joint ventures, minority investments, earn-outs, deferred and contingent consideration, and structured or hybrid financing solutions.
  • Assess the financial, commercial, and counterparty implications of different transaction structures, including royalties, streams, prepayments, and offtake agreements.
  • Translate complex financial and operational findings into clear, actionable recommendations that support strategic and investment decisions.

    • Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in mergers and acquisitions, investment banking, transaction advisory, private equity, corporate development, or strategy consulting.
  • Hands-on experience supporting or executing live M&A transactions, on either the buy-side or sell-side, is highly desirable.
  • Additional business qualifications or professional training, such as an MBA, progress toward CFA certification, or equivalent practical commercial experience, are advantageous.
  • Strong knowledge of financial modeling, corporate valuation methodologies, transaction analysis, and acquisition financing instruments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of transaction structures and documentation, including term sheets, Share Purchase Agreements, shareholder agreements, and other relevant legal and commercial agreements.
  • Experience applying strategy consulting methodologies and structured problem-solving approaches, including hypothesis-driven analysis, market research, industry assessment, and competitive analysis.
  • Ability to interpret complex commercial, operational, and financial information and translate findings into clear investment recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using financial databases and research platforms such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg, or PitchBook considered an advantage.
  • Fluent English communication skills, with excellent written and verbal abilities for preparing professional reports, investment materials, and executive-level presentations.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving capabilities, combined with sound commercial judgment and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and transaction workstreams simultaneously while meeting demanding deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, external advisors, and senior decision-makers.
  • Previous experience in mining and metals, agribusiness, or infrastructure is considered a significant advantage.
  • Exposure to cross-border transactions, additional language capabilities, and willingness to travel internationally to meet target companies, visit assets, and engage with counterparties are desirable.

    • Benefits

  • Fully remote opportunity: Work from anywhere in the world.
  • Global exposure: Participate in complex M&A transactions, strategic investments, and business development opportunities across multiple industries and geographical markets.
  • High-impact responsibilities: Contribute directly to significant investment decisions, corporate strategy initiatives, and transaction execution.
  • Professional development: Expand your expertise in financial analysis, corporate finance, valuation, deal structuring, and strategic consulting.
  • International collaboration: Work alongside experienced professionals, specialist advisors, and senior stakeholders across a globally distributed organization.
  • Career advancement: Gain valuable exposure to complex transactions and strategic projects in a dynamic, innovation-focused environment.
  • Compensation: Competitive remuneration package, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and demonstrated expertise.
  • Continuous learning: Opportunity to deepen industry knowledge and develop expertise across emerging markets, investment opportunities, and diverse business sectors.

  • Evaluate structural degradation, including corrosion-related section loss, deformation, vibration, fatigue, and overstress conditions.

  • Conduct load assessments covering dead loads, live loads, thermal loads, wind, seismic activity, and equipment loads.

  • Verify structural adequacy for brownfield modifications, revamp projects, equipment replacements, and structural tie-ins.

  • Assess the suitability of existing structures for additional loads and modified operating conditions.

  • Support API 579 Part 5 and Part 9 assessments where applicable to structural components, including local thin areas and crack-like flaws.

  • Review legacy structural drawings, as-built documentation, inspection records, and field measurements to validate structural capacity.

  • Provide structural engineering input for revamp packages, Management of Change (MOC) processes, and tie-in feasibility studies.

  • Support temporary works assessments, lifting studies, and construction-related structural checks.

  • Interpret inspection findings and correlate identified degradation mechanisms with structural performance.

  • Prepare structural assessment reports, engineering justifications, and recommendations for repair, reinforcement, or replacement.

  • Collaborate with Mechanical, Corrosion, Process, and Inspection teams to resolve technical uncertainties and ensure consistent engineering decisions.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant international standards and applicable client requirements, including Eurocodes, AISC, ASCE, and API.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has a strong background in civil or structural engineering, with practical experience assessing existing industrial structures and supporting operational or brownfield projects. You should combine sound technical knowledge with the ability to interpret inspection findings, apply engineering standards, and communicate reliable recommendations.

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering; a Master's degree in Structural Engineering is an advantage.

  • At least 5 years of demonstrable experience working as a Structural Integrity Engineer.

  • Chartered Engineer status (CEng, PE, EUR Ing, or equivalent).

  • Experience using structural analysis software for assessment-level calculations.

  • Strong understanding of structural analysis principles, load combinations, and code-based assessment methodologies.

  • Proven ability to assess non-pressurized structural elements, including steel and concrete structures, pipe racks, platforms, supports, and foundations.

  • Practical knowledge of evaluating corrosion, section loss, deformation, vibration, and fatigue-related structural issues.

  • Familiarity with API 579, particularly Parts 5 and 9, is an advantage.

  • Relevant training in structural assessment, Eurocodes, or API/ASME integrity standards is beneficial.

  • Experience with operational constraints, plant walkdowns, and brownfield engineering practices.

  • Working knowledge of structural integrity management systems and inspection workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to produce technically robust engineering assessments.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and inspection teams.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote working arrangement.

  • Opportunity to contribute to projects across multiple energy assets and operational facilities.

  • Exposure to brownfield modifications, revamp projects, and structural life-extension initiatives.

  • Opportunity to apply specialist engineering expertise in an international, multidisciplinary environment.

UGC Creator, Short-Form Video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)

As a UGC Creator, you will produce original short-form content designed to connect with travel enthusiasts and communicate the value of group travel. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Create and publish at least one unique short-form video per day throughout the 30-day campaign.

  • Produce engaging content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, cross-posting each original video across all three platforms.

  • Develop attention-grabbing opening hooks that capture viewers' interest within the first few seconds.

  • Translate campaign prompts and structured concepts into natural, relatable videos that feel like conversations with friends.

  • Use trending audio, CapCut templates, and current short-form video formats to maximize engagement.

  • Build and manage dedicated social media accounts focused exclusively on the campaign.

  • Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and deliver content independently, without requiring close supervision.

  • Represent the campaign on camera, communicating its message through authentic and energetic storytelling.

    The ideal candidate is a confident content creator with a strong interest in travel, social media trends, and community-driven experiences.   • Between 18 and 30 years old.

  • Based in the United States, European Union, Canada, or the United Kingdom.

  • Able to create and publish at least one video per day consistently.

  • Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

  • Strong understanding of trending audio, short-form video formats, and engaging content hooks.

  • Experience with fast-paced video editing tools such as CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms.

  • Comfortable being the face of a social media channel and delivering scripted or structured prompts naturally.

  • Creative, energetic, reliable, and able to work independently.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for travel and an understanding of the challenges of organizing trips with friends.

  • A belief in making group travel accessible to people who do not want to travel alone.

  • Previous experience using the platform, or an active background as a backpacker, study-abroad student, or digital nomad, is a plus.

    • Benefits:

  • Compensation: €20 per unique video, cross-posted across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

  • Total earning potential: €600 for completing the full 30-day campaign.

  • Opportunity to create content around travel, exploration, and shared experiences.

  • Oversee the performance of online sales channels, identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, conversion rates, retention, and average order value.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize paid media strategies across relevant digital advertising platforms to maximize return on advertising spend (ROAS) and marketing investment.
  • Lead customer acquisition and growth initiatives, using data-driven insights to improve campaign performance and commercial outcomes.
  • Manage e-commerce operations and digital sales performance, ensuring a seamless customer journey across all online touchpoints.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue, customer acquisition cost (CAC), conversion rates, lifetime value (LTV), and return on investment (ROI).
  • Identify emerging market trends, customer behaviors, and new growth opportunities to strengthen the organization's competitive position.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product, technology, and operations, to ensure effective execution of growth initiatives.
  • Establish performance reporting frameworks and provide strategic recommendations to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Build, mentor, and lead high-performing e-commerce and marketing teams, fostering accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements

  • Significant experience in senior leadership roles within e-commerce, digital marketing, growth marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful e-commerce and paid acquisition strategies that deliver measurable business growth.
  • Strong expertise in paid advertising platforms, campaign management, audience targeting, budget allocation, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage substantial marketing budgets while maximizing ROAS, improving CAC, and driving profitable customer acquisition.
  • In-depth understanding of e-commerce platforms, digital sales funnels, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and customer lifecycle management.
  • Strong analytical and strategic capabilities, with experience using marketing analytics, attribution tools, and performance dashboards to guide decisions.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, managing stakeholders, and driving complex projects from strategy through execution.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Commercially minded and highly results-oriented, with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable growth strategies.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
  • Strong understanding of emerging digital marketing trends, e-commerce technologies, and evolving customer acquisition strategies.

    • Benefits

  • Senior leadership opportunity: Take ownership of e-commerce and digital marketing strategy, with direct influence on business growth and commercial performance.
  • Competitive compensation: Salary and overall package to be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated results.
  • Strategic impact: Play a key role in shaping the organization's digital growth roadmap and long-term commercial direction.
  • Professional development: Opportunity to expand leadership experience and contribute to innovative digital business initiatives.
  • Collaborative environment: Work with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to deliver meaningful results.
  • Career growth: Opportunity to take on significant responsibilities within a strategic leadership position.
  • Work flexibility: Employment location based in India; specific remote or hybrid arrangements to be confirmed.

  • Personally develop and maintain strategic relationships with major referral sources and healthcare systems across markets.

  • Lead the admissions function from initial family contact through benefits verification, assessment, authorization, and the first service session.

  • Establish and monitor standards for response times, follow-up cadence, call quality, and conversion performance, ensuring teams are appropriately staffed, trained, and coached.

  • Foster a consultative, service-oriented sales culture that communicates the value of available services and recommendations while supporting families with empathy.

  • Own the CRM as the central source of truth for referral relationships, leads, and funnel activity. Develop automations, dashboards, and reporting tools to improve visibility and team productivity.

  • Publish and act on weekly funnel reports segmented by discipline, location, and referral source.

  • Coordinate weekly demand and capacity reviews with clinical operations to align business development efforts with available staffing and appointment capacity.

  • Develop and manage the growth budget, tracking acquisition costs and cost per new client start across referral channels.

  • Oversee online review management and local search optimization to strengthen market visibility and generate inbound referrals.

As a Senior Data Scientist for Product at Legora you will turn data into decisions. ENGINEERING AT NABLA

Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale.




YOUR TEAM

At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product, and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership.
As a Senior ML Engineer, you’ll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a senior machine learning engineer, you’ll play a key role in redefining clinicians’ workflows, unlocking better care for patients, and ensuring Nabla remains at the forefront of AI innovation. You will take ownership of high-impact projects and contribute to the growth and maturity of our ML team and R&D processes.

Within a team of experts who have built large-scale production systems at Facebook, Google, and Microsoft, you will:

 - Lead ambitious ML projects, collaborating with multiple engineers to deliver impactful solutions.

 - Go beyond ambient scribing to fully redefine clinicians’ workflows with AI, unlocking transformative efficiencies and improved patient care.

 - Propose and guide experiments, model architectures, and data-labeling strategies to improve our speech-to-text, note generation, and normalization systems.

 - Implement, train, and deploy models in production, ensuring scalability and robustness in a live healthcare setting.

 - Optimize R&D processes, enabling the team to ship new models quickly and confidently as we scale.

 - Stay at the cutting edge of AI research, sharing expertise and fostering technical growth within the team.

 - By the time you’ve read this posting, Nabla will have transcribed 100 new hours of live audio and generated 500 new clinical notes, saving 125 hours of doctor time.

Why Numeric

Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era. Today's ERPs don't store a company's financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That's why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn't have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on. We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP), a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.

We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We've raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We're in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There's never been a better time to join.

Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)

About the Team

The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT.

Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time.

You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training.

This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals.

 - Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training.

 - Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods.

 - Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outcomes.

 - Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research.

 - Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities.

 - Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams.

 - Implement and debug experiments across large-scale deep learning research systems.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience.

 - Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post-training.

 - Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis-driven experimentation.

 - Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior.

 - Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real-world outcomes.

 - Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases.

 - Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post-training.

 - Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals.

 - Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and biased feedback.

 - Experience connecting machine learning research with real-world product behavior.

Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing

About the Team

The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Post Training organization.

Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT.

Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship.

We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required.

In this role, you will

 - Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals.

 - Lead high-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard-to-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models.

 - Build RL environments for difficult-to-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings.

 - Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss.

 - Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training.

 - Build new 0→1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

 - Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements.

 - Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users.

You might thrive in this role if you

 - Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models.

 - Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post-training research, especially in a hard-to-verify area; or combine strong LLM research skills with deep expertise in education, mental health, or a related field of human benefit.

 - Are a hands-on builder who can turn ideas into rigorous experiments, write and debug code, and work directly with data and training infrastructure.

 - Have the taste to choose consequential problems and actionable steps on the path to solving those problems.

 - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and choose methods based on the impact they can deliver, including when the most useful work is unglamorous.

 - Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype.

 - Work well across disciplines and can grok the most important bottlenecks to scaling our impact in a multidisciplinary problem.

If you’re excited about ensuring AI systems advance human flourishing, we’d love to hear from you.

The Health team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training organization, has a mission to ensure AGI improves health for all humanity.

Increasingly capable models create an opportunity to make high-quality medical intelligence more accessible across patients and clinicians—raising the floor of human health—and accelerate the new capabilities and scientific advances that raise the ceiling of human health.

Our job is to make those benefits real. We work across the full model stack—pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, post-training, evaluations, harnessing, and deployment—and connect that research to the patients, clinicians, and real-world outcomes we aim to improve.

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher who wants to build frontier health capabilities and turn them into impact at scale. We’re especially excited about two kinds of people: researchers with the technical depth to move the frontier in pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, or evals; and researchers with real depth in developing frontier biomedical AI capabilities.  - Own a high-leverage research direction end to end—from deciding which problem matters and how to measure it, to designing and running experiments, to integrating successful work into frontier models.

 - Develop scalable methods across pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, and post-training to improve health reasoning, knowledge, reliability, calibration, and behavior.

 - Build and study RL environments grounded in real health problems; understand which data and training setups produce robust, generalizable improvements rather than just higher benchmark scores.

 - Create meaningful, trustworthy, and unsaturated evaluations that tell us whether our models are actually getting better at what matters for patients and clinicians.

 - Advance new 0→1 capabilities in health that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

 - Develop models and agents that can work over longitudinal, multimodal health data to produce useful predictions, surface new scientific insights, and support better individual- and population-level decisions.

 - Care deeply about using increasingly capable AI to improve human health, and take seriously the responsibility of deploying it safely.

Ever built an automation that saved hours of manual work, only to discover the real problem was the process itself?

That's exactly the kind of challenge you'll tackle at Oyster.

We help companies employ people across dozens of countries. Behind every successful payroll cycle are hundreds of details that need to be right: benefits, expenses, time off, timesheets, salary changes, and country-specific requirements.

The challenge? Not all that information arrives neatly packaged. Some comes through payroll platforms and service systems. Other details are buried in emails, contracts, receipts, attachments, or requests that need a human to make sense of them.

Your job is to turn that complexity into reliable, automated workflows.

You'll identify what's slowing teams down, question whether certain steps are needed at all, and build solutions that turn messy information into accurate, validated, payroll-ready data.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of defined automation projects, from understanding the problem and building a solution to launching it, monitoring performance, and making improvements.

You'll work with tools like n8n, Alteryx, SQL, APIs, and AI, but you won't be expected to use AI for everything. Sometimes the smartest solution is a simple rule, a better process, or preventing an issue before it happens.

And because your work directly affects people's pay, getting things right matters just as much as making them faster.

The goal? Less repetitive work, fewer avoidable issues, and smoother, more predictable payroll cycles across countries.




HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON:

 - Understand what really happens behind the scenes. Map payroll processes from start to finish, including how information moves between systems, where validation and calculations happen, what needs reconciling or reporting, and how deadlines, country-specific rules, and exceptions affect the process.

 - Find the work worth automating. Identify repetitive tasks, manual checks, and recurring problems. Use data to assess their impact on customers and Team Members, how often they happen, the risks involved, implementation effort, and whether a solution can work across countries.

 - Fix the process, not just the task. Question unnecessary steps and look for ways to prevent missing information, avoidable requests, and errors before they reach payroll.

 - Turn expert knowledge into reliable rules. Work with payroll and operations specialists to translate complex policies and requirements into clear, documented, version-controlled logic, including effective dates and required data.

 - Put AI to practical use. Use large language models (LLMs) to understand requests, extract information from documents and emails, and direct cases to the right place. Build validation checks so AI-generated outputs are verified before they affect payroll.

 - Build automations that actually run. Create, connect, and maintain workflows using n8n, Alteryx, and LLM-based tools, integrating service platforms, payroll systems, databases, APIs, and internal tools.

 - Know when not to automate with AI. Choose between rule-based logic, workflow automation, AI, and human review depending on the task. Keep predictable legal and policy requirements in transparent, auditable rules, and document your decisions.

 - Build reliability into every workflow. Include audit trails, error handling, alerts, exception queues, and appropriate approval controls. Make sure records are never silently changed, dropped, or excluded.

 - Test before it matters. Build prototypes quickly, then test them against real payroll scenarios, unusual cases, and exceptions. Use shadow testing and parallel runs before introducing changes that affect live payroll.

 - Make payroll operations more proactive. Automate timely information sharing, payroll-input checks, the identification of exceptions that affect pay, and reconciliation between payroll and invoices.

 - Own what happens after launch. Track performance, measure whether automations deliver the expected improvements, troubleshoot issues, and improve or retire solutions that aren't working.

 - Work with the teams building the bigger picture. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data when a problem needs a lasting platform-level solution. Turn operational insights into clear requirements and working examples they can build on.

 - Handle sensitive information responsibly. Apply privacy, security, and responsible-AI standards, especially when working with health, leave, or other sensitive payroll information. Make sure uncertain or compliance-sensitive cases reach the right people for review.

You'll likely enjoy this role if you like getting into the details of how things work, spotting opportunities others miss, and building solutions yourself.
